context: A boss mentors a uni intern on business basics
purpose: Teach: 返答/内訳/値上がり/倍増/消耗/受給/心得/規律

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、原料の値上がり、企業財務に倍増の影響を与える時もある。
lines.en: Ren, raw material costs can sometimes double the impact on company finances.
lines.style: Measured, leaning forward slightly. Opens with quiet weight on the instruction. Paced to let each phrase settle. A teach-moment, not a lecture.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 費用の内訳、慎重に分析が必要なんですね。
lines.en: So we need to analyze the cost breakdown carefully, then.
lines.style: Quick uptake, almost a question — checking his understanding aloud. Respectful lean-in. Soft uncertainty underneath the earnestness, seeking confirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 取引先からの返答、ずれることもある。心得として備えておけ。
lines.en: Vendor responses don't always line up with expectations. Keep that in mind as a matter of principle.
lines.style: Slower cadence, deliberate. Light pause before the principle—it matters. Not warning, but seasoning with experience. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 人件費の受給管理、規律ある運用が大事ですね。
lines.en: Personnel budget management really does need disciplined execution, doesn't it.
lines.style: Affirming his own realization out loud. Careful, wanting to get it right. A slight hitch—not doubt, but the sound of someone internalizing something that will matter later.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 消耗品費の管理も、見落とすな。
lines.en: And don't overlook consumable costs. They add up quietly.
lines.style: Final point, almost an afterthought that isn't. Warm but firm. The small things matter — delivered like someone who's learned this the hard way.
